scope: Source/build notice input inventory for the pinned FFmpeg build. Includes nested and build/test material; not a final linked-runtime SBOM, completed notice bundle or redistribution approval.
selection: Case-insensitive basename prefixes LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT/PATENTS/AUTHORS, excluding .git/.svn and xz build-aux/license-check.sh (a checker program). Five header notice blocks from the selected nv-codec-headers series supplement named files.
original_bytes: Every named notice is preserved as raw bytes and SHA256. Four files do not decode as UTF-8; Windows-1252 was inspected for display only, not asserted as original encoding.
git_heads: 117 direct root/nested/module HEAD values were collected, excluding reflogs and remote refs. This alone does not verify gitlinks, worktrees or actual linked components.
